BiblicalUsage: Jehukal is Jehucal, an Israelite sent by Zedekiah to Jeremiah. In Jeremiah 37:3, Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Jehucal is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
